subject: prd/argus-ledger-lint
statement: Every existing docgate check's verdict on every non-ledger tree is byte-identical before and after the two arms are added
rationale: additive composition is the whole point; a verdict change anywhere else is a regression (distributed-check-registration A-4)
fit_criterion: on the pre-existing gate corpus (all non-ledger trees), `docgate gate` output is byte-identical with and without the two arms
